dogecoin.text:
So, where will #doge #dogecoin end up an hour after #SNL with #ElonMusk? #DogeCoinTo1Dollar?

* IF you're going to buy any, here's the Robinhood link so you can get free stock, too https://t.co/OKVBKkNuRv

Most in this poll voted #dogecoin #doge would be $1 or more an hour after #ElonMusk #ElonSNL #SNL appearance.

Instead, the price dropped to 53 cents (55 at the time of this tweet).

For perspective, it had gone up to 73 cents earlier in the day.
